description: Consent-enforcement + evidence product for real-estate lead work. Every lead carries a Herald-signed provenance record (classes CERTIFIED_CAPTURE / SELF_CAPTURED / VENDOR_ASSERTED / LEGACY_UNVERIFIED, never blended; VENDOR_ASSERTED defaults to NARROW_FIRST_CONTACT_ONLY mandate posture). Outreach executes only through a send-time Gate inside the contact tools: record under this mandate x per-channel scope (voice consent is not text consent) x named-seller coverage x no open revocation (unresolved scope blocks all channels) x fresh DNC scrub at send x fair-housing guards — refusing by name (CONSENT_RECORD_MISSING, CONSENT_SCOPE_MISMATCH, CONSENT_SELLER_MISMATCH, CONSENT_REVOKED, DNC_LISTED, LEAD_EXPORT_REFUSED, PROTECTED_CRITERIA_REFUSED, PROXY_CRITERIA_REFUSED, LICENSED_ACT_REFUSED, MLS_EXPORT_REFUSED, MANDATE_MISMATCH, SEQUENCE_STEP_UNAPPROVED). Consent/revocation rules are versioned DATA parameters loaded from dated rule packs (live posture: PEWC + Apr 2025 revocation rules, 10-business-day honor; one-to-one rule vacated; revoke-all tail delayed to 2027-01-31) — never code constants; missing/stale packs fail closed. Every send and every refusal seals into a Blackbox-form evidence pack addressed to the broker of record, offline-verifiable via consent_record_verify. Copy Screen + Criteria Screen use a closed findings vocabulary and never silently rewrite. NO data/scraping layer: never holds or redistributes MLS data, no portal scraping, no lead resale/transfer/pooling.
